gaps.recommendation: Agree an owner and gather evidence: Are required data sources identified and owned?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Is data quality measured for the intended use?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Are access controls and lawful use understood?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Can data lineage and changes be traced?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Are data issues monitored and resolved by named roles?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Is there an agreed business outcome for AI investment?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Are use cases prioritised against measurable value?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Does an accountable sponsor own the AI strategy?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Are investment assumptions reviewed using evidence?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Are decisions to scale or stop tied to agreed measures?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Is a team accountable for delivering and running the service?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Is the work planned around outcomes and small increments?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Are delivery flow and service measures visible?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Are operating responsibilities and handovers documented?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Are improvements driven by feedback from production use?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Are intended use and foreseeable harms documented?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Are accountable risk owners and review routes named?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Are privacy, security and legal constraints assessed?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Are human oversight and incident routes tested?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Are governance controls reviewed when the system changes?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Do affected colleagues understand the intended workflow?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Are practical AI skills matched to the roles involved?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Are users involved in design and evaluation?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Is adoption supported with time, training and feedback?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Are skills and behaviour changes measured over time?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Are model and platform choices documented against needs?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Are integrations tested in a controlled environment?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Are reliability, cost and latency monitored?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Are evaluation and rollback mechanisms in place?
Agree an owner and gather evidence: Can the service be operated and changed without vendor lock-in?
